# WorktreeWise - AI Agent Index

## Overview
WorktreeWise helps developers manage Git worktrees, automate workflows, and work on multiple branches efficiently.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.worktreewise.com/) - Overview of the product and features
- [Documentation](https://docs.worktreewise.com/) - Guides and usage instructions
- [Features](https://www.worktreewise.com/) - Detailed feature breakdown

## Capabilities

- Manage Git worktrees (create, delete, move, lock)
- Run workflows across multiple worktrees
- Execute pre and post hooks
- Open worktrees in IDEs

## Target Users

- Developers working on multiple branches
- Teams managing parallel development
